spec_phase.title: Spec Creation Phase
spec_phase.description: The agent is creating a detailed specification for your feature
spec_phase.explanation: The spec agent is analyzing your request and creating a comprehensive specification that defines exactly what will be built. This includes user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.
spec_phase.importance: A clear spec ensures the implementation meets your needs and provides a reference point for quality assurance. It's like creating a blueprint before building a house.

explainMore.title: What is a spec?
explainMore.whatIsSpec: A specification (spec) is a detailed document that describes:

components.userStories: User stories - who needs this feature and why
components.acceptance: Acceptance criteria - what success looks like
components.technical: Technical requirements - how it should work
components.context: Context - relevant code patterns and dependencies

explainMore.discovery: The spec agent discovers existing code patterns, analyzes dependencies, and researches best practices to create a comprehensive plan.
explainMore.review: You'll have a chance to review and approve the spec before implementation begins.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint: Review Spec
checkpoint.description: The spec has been created. You can review it to ensure it matches your expectations before moving to implementation.

planning_phase.title: Planning Phase
planning_phase.description: The agent is creating an implementation plan with subtasks
planning_phase.explanation: The planner agent is breaking down the spec into concrete, actionable subtasks. Each subtask targets specific files and has clear verification steps.
planning_phase.importance: Breaking work into subtasks makes progress trackable, enables parallel execution, and makes it easier to recover from errors. It's like having a detailed checklist for a complex project.

explainMore.title: How does planning work?
explainMore.strategy: The planner analyzes the spec and creates a dependency-aware plan:

components.subtasks: Subtasks - individual units of work with clear goals
components.files: File targets - which files to create or modify
components.verification: Verification - how to test each subtask
components.dependencies: Dependencies - which tasks must complete first

explainMore.parallel: Subtasks that don't depend on each other can run in parallel, speeding up development.
explainMore.tracking: Each subtask has status tracking (pending, in_progress, completed, failed) so you can see exactly where the build is.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint: Review Plan
checkpoint.description: The implementation plan is ready. Review the subtasks to understand what will be built and in what order.

coding_phase.title: Coding Phase
coding_phase.description: The agent is implementing the feature autonomously
coding_phase.explanation: The coder agent is implementing each subtask by reading relevant files, following code patterns, and writing clean, maintainable code. It runs verification commands after each subtask to ensure correctness.
coding_phase.importance: Autonomous coding follows existing patterns, maintains code quality, and handles complex multi-file changes consistently. It's like having an experienced developer who never gets tired or makes careless mistakes.

explainMore.title: How does the coder agent work?
explainMore.process: The coder follows a systematic approach:

steps.read: Read pattern files to understand existing code style
steps.analyze: Analyze files to modify and their context
steps.verify: Run verification commands to check correctness

explainMore.patterns: The agent studies existing code patterns (like similar components) to maintain consistency across your codebase.
explainMore.recovery: If a subtask fails verification, the agent can retry with a recovery strategy or escalate for review.
explainMore.subagents: For complex work, the agent can spawn subagents to work on independent subtasks in parallel.

coding_phase.realTimeUpdates: Watch the progress in real-time as each subtask is completed

qa_phase.title: QA Review Phase
qa_phase.description: The QA agent is validating the implementation
qa_phase.explanation: The QA reviewer agent is checking the implementation against the spec's acceptance criteria. It reviews code quality, tests functionality, and ensures all requirements are met.
qa_phase.importance: Automated QA catches issues early, ensures acceptance criteria are met, and maintains high code quality. It's like having a dedicated QA engineer review every change.

explainMore.title: What does QA review?
explainMore.checks: The QA agent performs comprehensive validation:

criteria.acceptance: Acceptance criteria - all requirements from spec met
criteria.code: Code quality - follows patterns, no console.log, proper error handling
criteria.integration: Integration - changes work with existing code
criteria.e2e: End-to-end testing - UI flows work as expected (for frontend changes)

explainMore.testing: For frontend changes, the QA agent can use the Electron MCP server to perform automated end-to-end testing by interacting with the running application.

outcomeTypes.approved: Approved - all criteria met, ready to merge
outcomeTypes.fixable: Fixable Issues - minor issues that can be automatically fixed

explainMore.fixes: If fixable issues are found, the QA fixer agent will automatically address them and re-run validation.
